titleAr: الدفع بانستاباي ورفع الإيصال وإلغاء الطلب أو الاعتراض على الرفض
titleEn: Pay by InstaPay (package or top-up) with receipt upload, cancel a request, contest a rejection

en: How do I pay with InstaPay?
How do I cancel an InstaPay request?

steps: Send the exact amount to our InstaPay address with the WA- reference in the note
Reviewed within 4 business hours Sun-Thu 9-17 Cairo; confirmed activates, rejected shows reason
Before a receipt is sent: Cancel the request (nothing is owed)
After a rejection (within 30 days, once): Ask for a second review with a note; a person reviews it again, nothing is confirmed by the request
edgeCases: Reference valid 48h; expired = start a new request
Large amounts need a second operator
Cancel is refused once a receipt was sent (a person decides it: the transfer may have happened)
Contest is once only, within 30 days, not for a system decision, not while 5 requests are open or the workspace is being closed; it never confirms or credits anything
gaps: Confirmation is operator-only today (BLOCKER #4) so activation waits for staff
assistantNote: money-in; merchant sends the bank transfer themselves
